crossRefs.note: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, that it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may…
There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that…
This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend…

translations.web: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
translations.bsb: Now to the unmarried and widows I say this: It is good for them to remain unmarried, as I am.
translations.kjv: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even ➔ as I.
translations.asv: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
